# Synthetic annotation capture

All words, app names, window titles, marks and images here are invented.
The bundle has two 480 by 270 PNGs, twelve timed words and three marks.
Marks 1 and 2 share frame 1. Mark 3 uses frame 2. Frames are deliberately
stored out of order in scrawl.json to exercise ordering by capture time.

No recording or audio is included. Tests create locked placeholder media and
a sparse oversized file in a temporary folder to prove neither is read.
